description: This Java class 'CodeGenerator' provides methods to generate and modify Android navigation-related code, such as adding transition handlers and menu setup code, within Android project source files.

classes.name: CodeGenerator
classes.description: A class that programmatically generates and modifies Android navigation code, including menu handling and activity transition code, within Android project source files.

methods.name: getAssociatedActivityState
methods.description: Finds and returns the ActivityState associated with a given MenuState within the navigation model.

methods.name: implementTransition
methods.description: Implements a navigation transition by injecting code into Android activity classes to handle menu creation, menu item selection, and activity launching based on transition details.
